title: Page 185
transc:
No 2
Beckwith City Pt  Wash. Sep. 27. 1864
Hannah Nelson Downing Crowd The Clarke Brussels
Webbs will not make Austin ---- a
consolidation was repeated a week ago but is
not yet completed the fragments being scattered
tanner state ---- flora whifs urging that 
all new widows savory would be sent to
subject his plantations ---- These waynes however 
will by your repeats be sent to Bridle
--- No reply has been recd from
you in regard to repair of Walnuts lady


No 32
To McCaine  Washn <insertion>12 M</insertion> Sept 28th 1864
Francis Wednesday harsh platine to Nabob zebra John
wrangles that he expects Ewell bable to push
forward to stand on or Bromley zodiac In
that case you can best be supplied blithe
orange weldon through Belly stop If not the
welch to reptile Royal should be repaired unity 
The orange wiley canby repair head asfiras the
Audit in much the shortest time Please say
which windham you prefer walrus Jacob nothing from
you since No Lamp peach Sunday to Beckwith
